primitives.name: Princeton System Isomorphism
primitives.verbatim_quote: On offense the ends play well out and the backs are relied on to bear the large share of the attack.
primitives.assumptions: Uniform ball distribution across offensive linemen, linear backfield progression, constant velocity running backs.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Inefficient against blitzing defenses; prone to turnovers under pressure.

layer2.mapping: The Princeton system's structured, power-running foundation maps directly to GSI's conformal betting models for predictable, high-volume scoring plays and GSE's situational reasoning for controlled, zone-based defensive rotations.

primitives.name: Phil King Coaching Legacy
primitives.verbatim_quote: Wisconsin early appreciated the necessity for adequate coaching and, in the comparatively early days of the game in the west, invited Phil King, one of Princeton's most famous players, to journey west to take up the work of developing her team.
primitives.assumptions: Coach quality scales linearly with player performance; talent acquisition is exogenous.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Over-reliance on individual genius leads to collapse when coach departs.

layer2.mapping: The concept of foundational coaching leadership mirrors GSI's Bayesian hierarchical priors that stabilize predictive models, and GSE's state-transition logic where key personnel changes trigger strategic recalibration.
layer2.telemetry: Team win percentage after head coach turnover

primitives.name: Star Player Pool Dynamics
primitives.verbatim_quote: Among the stars of Wisconsin's many good teams were Larson, Driver, Curtis, Cochems, Lerum, Fogg, Abbott and Bush.
primitives.assumptions: Player performance follows a normal distribution; independent contributions sum additively.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Diminishing returns from additional star players due to coordination costs.

layer2.mapping: The aggregation of elite athletes creates a heavy-tailed distribution of team strength, aligning with GSI's extreme value theory for outlier outcomes and GSE's multi-agent reinforcement learning for optimal player coordination.
layer2.telemetry: Standard deviation of player rankings within a conference
